The extraction instructions correctly note this difference, but the block definition's sourceComponents array is incomplete.

issues.details: Cards block content model uses 3 cells per row (image | title+body | CTA) in blueprint, but block-inventory.json specifies 4 cells (image | title | body | CTA). The blueprint's consolidation of title+body into one cell is arguably more author-friendly (David's Model), but diverges from the inventory.
issues.remediation: Reconcile cards content model between blueprint (3 cells) and inventory (4 cells). The blueprint's 3-cell model is better for authors — update inventory to match.
